# Tranception — upstream-derived working copy `UPSTREAM_DERIVED` · `BASE RESEARCH AUTHORSHIP NOT CLAIMED`
This repository is retained as a working/reference copy of the upstream **Tranception** research codebase. **Official upstream:** https://github.com/OATML-Markslab/Tranception **Paper:** *Tranception: Protein Fitness Prediction with Autoregressive Transformers and Inference-time Retrieval* (Notin et al., ICML 2022) The Tranception research, paper, base implementation and primary authorship belong to the Marks Lab / OATML authors and upstream contributors. Hawkar does **not** claim authorship of that base research or code. ## How to evaluate this repository Any Hawkar-specific work should be evaluated only as an explicit diff against a corresponding upstream revision. - Attribution notice: [`UPSTREAM_MIRROR_NOTICE.md`](UPSTREAM_MIRROR_NOTICE.md) - Machine-readable status: [`PROJECT_STATUS.json`](PROJECT_STATUS.json) - Official documentation / releases / citations: [upstream repository](https://github.com/OATML-Markslab/Tranception) ```text PORTFOLIO_CLASS = UPSTREAM_DERIVED_WORKING_COPY BASE_RESEARCH_AUTHORSHIP_CLAIMED_BY_HAWKAR = FALSE BASE_CODE_AUTHORSHIP_CLAIMED_BY_HAWKAR = FALSE FLAGSHIP_HAWKAR_RESEARCH = FALSE ``` Licensing and citation requirements remain those of the upstream project and included license files.
